title: Debiasing: reducing bias introduced by the wording

videos.script: Every prompt says more than you meant it to. The order you list the labels in. A sentence about what most messages are. Which examples you happened to paste. {{wording}} None of those is an instruction, and a model can act on all of them. This lesson measures four of them, on the same seventy messages. {{runs}} Reversing the list of labels moves four answers, and three go to the label that now comes first. {{order}} One sentence saying most messages are about delivery moves eight. Every one of them goes to delivery. {{leading}} Four billing examples out of five pull twenty-three answers to billing that a balanced set does not. {{skewed}} Then you change only the customer's name, and nothing moves at all. In this lab that proves nothing, and you will see why. {{names}} By the end you can find a bias you wrote yourself. You change one thing, and you compare the answers. {{close}}
